sources.aurora_project_report.txt:
PROJECT AURORA — EXECUTIVE PROJECT REPORT
Document ID: AUR-PR-2026-04
Version: 1.2
Date: 20 April 2026

1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
Project Aurora is a customer analytics platform scheduled for production readiness in Q2 2026.

2. TIMELINE
The approved baseline completion date is 30 April 2026.
Major milestones:
- M1 Requirements complete: 15 January 2026
- M2 Architecture complete: 31 January 2026
- M3 Development complete: 31 March 2026
- M4 Production readiness: 30 April 2026

3. APPROVED BUDGET
The approved project budget is INR 380,000.

4. STATUS
The project team reports that all major development activities are progressing against the approved baseline.

5. GOVERNANCE NOTE
Any material change to the approved baseline should be documented through a formal change request and reflected in the financial records.
sources.aurora_financial_report.txt:
PROJECT AURORA — FINANCIAL STATUS REPORT
Document ID: AUR-FIN-2026-05
Reporting period: 1 January 2026 to 14 May 2026

1. FINANCIAL SUMMARY
Total expenditure recorded to date: INR 450,000.

2. CURRENT STATUS
The financial team records expenditure above the original approved project budget.

3. DATES
The latest recorded completion milestone is 14 May 2026.

4. VARIANCE
The report identifies expenditure of INR 450,000 against an approved baseline of INR 380,000.

5. NOTE
This report does not contain the formal change-request reference authorising the additional expenditure.

PROJECT AURORA — MILESTONE UPDATE
Document ID: AUR-MIL-2026-05
Date: 14 May 2026

MILESTONE M4
M4 — Production readiness — status: CLOSED
Recorded closure date: 14 May 2026.

BASELINE
The original baseline completion date is not reproduced in this document.

CHANGE CONTROL
A formal baseline-change request number is not recorded in this milestone update.

COMMENT
This document confirms the observed milestone closure date, but it does not establish whether the original approved baseline was formally changed.

report.objective: Investigate the Aurora project reports and identify any contradictions between the timeline and the financial information.

sections.heading: Executive Summary
sections.narrative: The investigation identified two verified contradictions between the Aurora project's timeline and financial reports: the approved completion date of 30 April 2026 versus the financial report's 14 May 2026, and a budget discrepancy of 450,000 versus 380,000. These inconsistencies indicate misalignment between project planning and financial documentation. No other contradictions or gaps were found in the reports.

sections.heading: Investigation Scope
items: Objective: Investigate the Aurora project reports and identify any contradictions between the timeline and the financial information.
Examined: the knowledge pass read 3 of 3 section(s) across 3 of 3 document(s)
Examined: 3 of 7 evidence-gathering step(s) found matching passages

sections.heading: Verified Findings
items: [F-001] The project's approved completion date is 30 April 2026 according to the project report, but the financial report states 14 May 2026 as the completion date (CONTRADICTION, confidence 0.94; aurora_project_report.txt:r10 [Report or analysis], aurora_project_report.txt:r15 [Report or analysis], aurora_financial_report.txt:r12 [Report or analysis])

[F-002] The project's budget for the financial year is reported as 450,000 in the financial report but 380,000 in the project report (CONTRADICTION, confidence 0.94; aurora_financial_report.txt:r15 [Report or analysis], aurora_project_report.txt:r18 [Report or analysis])

sections.heading: Reasoning
sections.narrative: The timeline discrepancy between the project report and financial report directly contradicts the expected completion date, while the budget difference between the two reports represents a clear financial inconsistency. Both findings are independent but highlight a systemic misalignment between project management and financial tracking processes.

sections.heading: Confidence
items: [F-001] 0.94 = resolved 1.00 x 0.94 (evidence strength 0.20x1.00, independence 0.25x0.85, authority 0.10x0.75, verification 0.35x1.00, temporal consistency 0.10x1.00)
[F-002] 0.94 = resolved 1.00 x 0.94 (evidence strength 0.20x1.00, independence 0.25x0.85, authority 0.10x0.75, verification 0.35x1.00, temporal consistency 0.10x1.00)

sections.heading: Limitations
items: 2 of 9 extracted claim(s) were not found on their source line and were not used as evidence (the model wrote values it did not read)
